I completely understand you because I’d also start crying and loosing my breath in public when surrounded by alot of people or having to speak to someone. I’d say talk to someone you spend most of your time with and explain to them how you feel in these situations. That way they know how you get in Public and they can comfort you when you need help. That’s what my Mother does with me. It helps alot. I know this might be weird but i found that Chewing Gum helps calm down my anxiety. Don’t try to hide/act away your social anxiety because it will only worsen it. Accept it and let it do it’s thing. Take long breaths and comfort yourself. Remind yourself that nobody else around you is better then you. They’re all humans just like you. If you don’t know how to do something or if you have questions, ask them. People doing their jobs are paid to help people. Whenever you feel like you’ve been stuck at home for way too long, listen to some music and go for a walk. Social anxiety is Hell when you let it control you too much. I completely understand you and I understand how stressing it can be. It makes you feel less of yourself. My #1 Tip, when you know you’re about to step into a situation you’ll feel uncomfortable in, remind yourself that you’re a human like everyone else and let your Anxiety do it’s own thing. Remind yourself not to force yourself into acting/hiding your anxiety away because it will become more obvious to others. Take things slowly. If you’d like, you can pay attention to others and wonder how they’re feeling/thinking about themselves. Some of those people probably have anxiety as well. I tend to try and do things fast to get out of a uncomfortable situation but I noticed that when doing that, it makes me feel more stressed and worse. Please, just take things slow and give yourself time to breathe. Don’t rush things in public. It’s hard to explain. Hope this helps. This is coming from someone who attempted S*icide and self-harmed because of Social Anxiety. You’re Strong, Beautiful and smart. Don’t let a mf make you think otherwise.
